metadata.description: Plugins made with Plugin Creator: focused Claude plugins for industries and tools the official directory does not cover yet.

plugins.name: plugin-creator
plugins.description: Go from a plugin idea to a published, tested Claude plugin: live demand check, design brief, strict-valid scaffold, skills that trigger, evals with a no-plugin baseline, .plugin packaging, directory listings and traction tracking.

plugins.name: plugin-studio
plugins.description: Run a portfolio of Claude plugins like a studio: rank gaps with live demand data, track every published plugin's traction daily, and get a kill / iterate / double-down verdict at day 30 against thresholds set before launch.

plugins.name: make-my-plugin
plugins.description: Turn the way you already do a recurring task into your own Claude plugin, no coding. Claude interviews you, learns from two or three past examples of your work, and hands you a ready-to-install plugin that does it your way every time.

plugins.name: grounded-scala
plugins.description: Scala language server (Metals) and workflow skills for Claude Code: type errors after every edit, symbol-true navigation, and a compile-fix loop that keeps the build warm.

plugins.name: analyzer-loop
plugins.description: Dart analysis server LSP for Claude Code plus Flutter/Dart workflow skills (fix-analyzer-errors loop, major package upgrades, Android Gradle/AGP/Kotlin build fixer, golden tests, Riverpod 3 and Bloc 9 state management) that complement, not duplicate, Google's official dart-flutter plugin.

plugins.name: merge-medic
plugins.description: Fix red GitLab pipelines and review merge requests from Claude Code through the glab CLI: failed-job log triage, draft-only MR review, MR creation and thread resolution. Works on self-managed GitLab, no MCP or admin toggle.

plugins.name: helpdesk
plugins.description: Queue triage, SLA-risk ranking, on-brand reply drafts, thread summaries and weekly insights for support teams on Zendesk or Freshdesk, working from an export file or an optional connector.

plugins.name: structured-hiring
plugins.description: Structured hiring for founders, hiring managers and recruiters: debrief packets from scorecards, interview kits, pay-transparent job descriptions, pipeline updates and outreach drafts, from your ATS or a paste. It never scores or ranks candidates.

plugins.name: deal-tender
plugins.description: Pipeline triage, call logging, forecast briefs and meeting prep for Pipedrive users: ranks stale deals, drafts follow-ups, and proposes CRM updates you approve. Try it on a CSV export, no login.

plugins.name: listing-desk
plugins.description: Listing appointment prep and listing launch for US residential real estate agents: a CMA from your own MLS CSV export, listing copy, and a Fair Housing check on every word, plus contract deadlines and follow-up drafts.

plugins.name: construction-pm
plugins.description: Project-engineer sidekick for small GCs and subs: spec sections to a cited submittal register, plus RFIs, daily reports, meeting minutes, change-order backup and 3-week look-aheads, all from your own files.

plugins.name: restaurant-ops
plugins.description: Plate costing, invoice price tracking, menu engineering, allergen matrix drafts and labor schedule drafts for independent restaurants, computed by bundled scripts on your own CSV exports.

plugins.name: grant-desk
plugins.description: Grant writing desk for small nonprofits: free funder research from public 990-PF grantee lists and Grants.gov, source-tagged proposal drafts that never invent a number, logic models, deadline tracking and donor thank-yous.
